purpose: Turn the historical v25.4 'latitude_58_symmetry' label into one explicit mathematical operator and test it against geographic nulls without changing the operator after seeing the result.

historical_source.historical_label: Зеркальная симметрия командных структур на 58° с.ш. Подтверждено.

primary_operator.metric: WGS84-like spherical great-circle distance using mean Earth radius R=6371.0088 km
primary_operator.test_statistic: D = great_circle_km(M58(A), B); smaller is more mirror-like
primary_operator.rationale: This is the most literal coordinate interpretation of the historical '58° north mirror' wording. It is not claimed to be a physical symmetry or a global spherical isometry.

secondary_negative_control.role: Parameter-free geometric negative control only; not a replacement hypothesis and not evidence if it happened to fit.

nulls.rationale: Conservative domain reflecting that both historical endpoints are in the northern hemisphere.

decision_rule.promotion: No promotion from HYPOTHESIS_ONLY unless the frozen operator is unusual under the preregistered null and survives an independent point set. This retrospective pair alone can never establish a physical law.
decision_rule.rejection: If p>=0.05 under the primary null, the historical 58-degree mirror claim is not geographically exceptional under this operator.
decision_rule.multiple_testing_guard: Do not shop additional mirror axes/operators after observing these results. Any future operator must be registered as a new hypothesis before evaluation.

epistemic_guard: The pair was known before this formula was formalized; therefore this is a falsification-oriented retrospective test.
The historical numeric value 0.58 is not a calibrated measurement and is not used in the null.
No UAP, nuclear-causation, or physical-field inference is permitted from a geometric match.
